verdict.rationale: Exa's docs show that Websets, its dashboard feature, can be built visually with 'no code required' (exa-docs-7/29) and that the same functionality is exposed via the Websets API (exa-docs-8/15/28), suggesting rough UI/API parity for that feature, and search/contents/answer are all API-first with UI as a thin layer (exa-comm-7). However there is no explicit documentation stating full feature parity between the dashboard and API, and no OpenAPI spec was found (exa-probe-3) to verify completeness. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or changelog showing every UI capability (e.g. dashboard analytics, billing controls, websets monitoring UI) is mirrored in the API, and independent confirmation that no UI-only features exist.
